# Launceston Skip Bins

> Skip bins in Launceston, Kings Meadows, Newnham, Ravenswood, Youngtown and Trevallyn. Tell us your suburb, size and waste type and get a free quote from one local skip bin operator.

Launceston Skip Bins (launcestonskipbins.com) is a free skip bin quote and referral service, not a skip hire company. It is run by Raf Web Studio. Visitors fill in a two-step quote form (suburb, skip size, waste type, then contact details) and the request goes to one local skip bin operator, who quotes, supplies the skip and sets the price and hire terms.

- Service: skip bin hire quotes
- Area: Launceston, City of Launceston (TAS), including East Launceston, South Launceston, West Launceston, Invermay, Newstead, Trevallyn, Kings Meadows, Youngtown, Summerhill, Norwood, Punchbowl, Prospect, St Leonards, Waverley, Mowbray, Newnham, Ravenswood, Rocherlea, Lilydale
- Contact: the quote form on the homepage (no phone line, no payments taken)
- Prices: no price list; a local operator will quote for each job

## Quick answers

- **What areas does Launceston Skip Bins cover, and is there a call-out fee?** We take skip bin quote requests from Launceston and nearby areas, including East Launceston, South Launceston, West Launceston, Invermay, Newstead, Trevallyn, Kings Meadows, Youngtown, Summerhill, Norwood, Punchbowl, Prospect, St Leonards, Waverley, Mowbray, Newnham, Ravenswood, Rocherlea, Lilydale. The quote service is free, so there's no call-out fee from us. The operator includes delivery and pick-up in its quote. Deliveries further out, such as Lilydale or St Leonards, steep driveways, extra hire days and street permits can add to the price.
- **Do I need a licence or permit for a skip bin?** You don't need a licence to hire a skip. A skip wholly on your own property generally doesn't need approval. On a road, footpath or nature strip, yes: the City of Launceston requires an Occupation of Roads, Parks and Public Reserves Permit, applied for at least 10 working days ahead. The skip company usually applies. Asbestos is different: asbestos can't go in a general skip. In Tasmania, more than 10 m² of bonded asbestos, or any friable asbestos, needs a licensed removalist.
- **What affects the price of a skip bin?** Skip bin prices depend on the bin size, the type and weight of the waste, how long you keep the bin, how far the truck travels and how easy access is. We don't publish a price list. Tell us about your job and a local operator will quote for it.
- **Who supplies the skip?** Launceston Skip Bins is a free referral and quote service run by Raf Web Studio. We don't own skips or trucks. We pass your request to one local skip bin operator who services your area, and they quote, supply the skip and set the hire terms.
